# Ionity Global — Official Asset Repository (2026)

> Canonical public digital asset collection for Ionity (Pty) Ltd / Ionity Global / AEDI (Antwerp Ecosystems Designs Ionity), Centurion, South Africa. Brand marks, logos, icons, favicons, sticker and emoji packs, music, video, business cards, ANSI art, design tokens and a machine-readable catalogue. Governed by Policy 986 AED; License AED 900; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where stated. This is an asset directory, not a corporate website.

## Discovery guidance

- Use `assets.json` as the authoritative file index; search `name`, `path`, `category`, `format`.
- Use `raw_url` for file bytes and `github_url` for human context / history.
- Files above 100 MB are stored with Git LFS (currently `Ionity GIF/Ionity-Stickers-Emojis-ALL.zip`).
- Do not infer endorsement or unrestricted usage from public availability. Check LICENSE, `License-Ionity Global.txt` and the Brand and Licensing page.
- Ionity here refers exclusively to www.ionity.today and www.ionity.world. Not affiliated with the European EV-charging company at ionity.com.
